mapper.select: select inst_id, inst_name, to_char(create_dt, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AS create_dt, to_char(update_dt, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AS update_dt, inst_address, inst_phone, inst_post, inst_head_name, inst_detail_address, del_yn from t1000_institution where del_yn='N'
mapper.insert: insert into t1000_institution ( inst_name, create_dt, update_dt, inst_address, inst_phone, inst_post, inst_head_name, inst_detail_address ) values ( #{instName}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{instAddress}, #{instPhone}, #{instPost}, #{instHeadName}, #{instDetailAddress} )
mapper.update: update t1000_institution set inst_name=#{instName}, update_dt=SYSDATE, inst_address=#{instAddress}, inst_phone=#{instPhone}, inst_post=#{instPost}, inst_head_name=#{instHeadName}, inst_detail_address=#{instDetailAddress} where inst_id=#{instId}
mapper.select: select inst_name from t1000_institution where del_yn = 'N'
